import numpy as np
def equation(t, x, v, params):
    w=params[0]
    C=np.cos(w*t); S=np.sin(w*t)
    base=(params[1]+params[2]*x+params[3]*v+params[4]*v**2+params[5]*x**2
          +params[6]*np.sin(x)+params[7]*np.sin(v)+params[8]*np.exp(-x)+params[9]*np.exp(-v))
